aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:801.title: Event Guest Services Staff - Pacific Northwest
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:801.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Position Summaries: BOX OFFICE ATTENDANT COAT CHECK STAFF VENUE HOST 1. BOX OFFICE ATTENDANT SUMMARY The Box Office Attendant is responsible for communicating information regarding the location, event, seating options, price structures, and other details to help guests select the best event ticket option. The Box Office Attendant will process ticket orders and collect payments. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Accurately and efficiently processes orders and collect payments from guests. Follow cash handling and inventory procedures to ensure security of assets. Greet customers with a positive and friendly demeanor. Assist guests by providing information, answering questions, and processing requests. Resolve customer concerns by providing superior customer service, utilizing common practices for resolution and escalating to supervisor when needed. Provide upselling opportunities to similar events in the genre by demonstrating a strong knowledge of upcoming events. Contribute to the team dynamic by assisting coworkers, maintaining the facilities’ cleanliness, and helping to develop and maintain a positive work environment. QUALIFICATIONS A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency A minimum of 1-2 years of cash-handling and related work experience Excellent customer service skills Must be able to work independently and in a team setting Good communication skills to effectively communicate with customers and co-workers Basic math skills Must be responsible and professional Effective decision-making skills Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment Must be self-motivated, reliable, and punctual Available to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays PAY SCALE: $23.00 BONUS These positions are not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. BENEFITS Event based positions are not eligible for benefits through AEG Presents. 2. COAT CHECK STAFF SUMMARY Coat Check Staff will act as one of the main providers of direct services to guests. They are responsible for various tasks such as checking coats in and out, selling concessions, and answering questions. Coat Check Staff will provide a variety of customer service duties on behalf of the venue in an expert, professional, and friendly manner. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Operate the various coat check areas within established guidelines and procedures at the venue. Greet guests, answer guest questions, resolve guest complaints, and direct guests to important areas of the venue (i.e., restrooms, ATM, ADA areas, VIP areas, merch, and concert area, etc.) and provide additional assistance whenever necessary. Cash handling duties and reconciliation of bank. Act as a member of the emergency evacuation team by communicating with and directing guests during a facility emergency. gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:cf481e28-.title: Data Engineer - MoneyLion
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:cf481e28-.description: About the Role The Kuala Lumpur office is the technology powerhouse of MoneyLion, where we measure anything and everything and rely on data to guide our decisions: both long-term strategies and day-to-day operations. Combine that backdrop with an incredible volume and sophistication of data and mix in MoneyLion’s voracious appetite for adopting paradigm-shifting technologies and you have the mission and mandate of the Data Engineering team. Now turbo-charged with a planetscale mandate as part of Gen Digital, we aim to leverage tried-and-true methodologies with game-changing technology to create a AI-native, scalable, extensible, and cost-effective data infrastructure across the Gen Digital enterprise and beyond. As a Data Engineer, you are a technical Individual Contributor (IC) figure within the team that will design, implement and optimize a Snowflake-centric architecture that will leverage many components of the modern data stack. You will be a trusted subject matter expert on dimensional data modeling, performant SQL query writing, infrastructure optimization, process automation and governance. You will be given the opportunity to leverage the latest and greatest AI tools and features, including Claude Code (Enterprise) and Snowflake’s Cortex Code, among many others. You will be responsible for designing and implementing an analytical environment using in-house and third-party tools, using Python and/or Java to automate data activities and enable efficient processing of data that is growing in both volume and complexity. You will design and implement complex data pipelines and data models for analytical consumption. You will write scalable and performant SQL queries running over billions of rows of data and design workflows aimed to ruthlessly streamline the governance of our complex layers of storage. You should have deep experience in designing and managing large datasets and pipelines to enable business use-cases. You should be an authority at designing, implementing and operating solutions that are scalable, stable and cost-efficient. Above all, you will be an authority on crafting thoughtful solutions that will empower absolutely everyone at Gen Digital towards an agentic AI-first analytics and development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities - Extensive expertise operating & optimizing a modern data warehousing solution (Snowflake preferred) from both performance and cost perspectives. - Expertise with Apache Kafka, real-time data processing, and event-driven architectures - Experience with Apache Iceberg, data lakehouse architectures, and modern table formats - Collaborate with data scientists, business analysts, product managers, software engineers and other data engineers to develop, implement and validate deployed data solutions. - Build and maintain data pipelines from internal databases and SaaS applications - Implement better solutions for data governance at scale, encompassing lineage, discoverability, and regulatory compliance. - Advocate best practices, uphold the highest standards for code maintainability and performance, and constantly champion our team’s core values of psychological safety and building in public. - Lead the team in honing our ways of working, coaching and mentoring junior engineers, and managing senior stakeholders from external departments. About You - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or related technical field - 1-4 years of hands-on data engineering experience in large-scale, high-volume environments - Expert-level proficiency in SQL optimization for multi-petabyte datasets and advanced Python programming - Experience with Snowflake architecture, optimization, and cost management at enterprise scale - Demonstrated expertise building Kimball dimensional data warehouses and star schema architectures, or equivalent experience with thoughtful, non-generic projects - Advanced experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and either DBT or SQLMesh for data transformations - Fa

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:372d7b09-c96.title: Field & Events Marketer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:372d7b09-c96.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobandtalent-jobandtalent:lever:195cbb53.title: SE - Senior Account Expansion Manager
jobandtalent-jobandtalent:lever:195cbb53.description: Join us to shape the future of work: your next adventure awaits! We are looking for a Senior Account Expansion Manager with a strong commercial mindset to drive growth across our portfolio of mid-sized and large clients in Sweden. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of expanding existing accounts and driving business growth within the staffing, recruitment, or talent solutions industry. You will combine a strong focus on delivering long-term customer value with the ability to leverage data, technology, and AI-driven insights to develop smart growth strategies and deliver high-impact solutions. In this strategic, client-facing role, you will be responsible for identifying, developing, and executing upselling and cross-selling opportunities within your assigned customer portfolio. You will achieve this through strategic account analysis and a deep understanding of your clients' needs across different departments, subsidiaries, and business units. You will take full ownership of your assigned portfolio and expansion pipeline, leading the entire sales process from end to end - from identifying and qualifying opportunities to developing proposals, structuring commercial agreements, negotiating terms, and closing deals.
responsibilities: Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within your assigned client portfolio by conducting strategic account analyses and uncovering growth opportunities across different departments, subsidiaries, and business units.

Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders within existing accounts, acting as a strategic partner and working closely with Customer Success and service delivery teams to strengthen engagement and customer trust.

Manage and lead the expansion pipeline from qualification through to close, taking full ownership of the sales process, including deal structuring, proposal development, negotiation, and contract execution.
Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure the successful execution and implementation of growth initiatives.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:10421aa7-d45a-.title: Lead Character Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:10421aa7-d45a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Character Artist based in United States. As Lead Character Artist, you will help define the visual direction and quality standards for character development on a major AAA game project. You will lead, mentor, and develop a talented team of character artists while setting a high bar for artistic and technical excellence. Working closely with Art, Design, Gameplay, Animation, Environment, and Engineering teams, you will help bring distinctive stylized characters to life. You will establish workflows, create exemplary assets, and ensure character work meets aesthetic, gameplay, and technical requirements. The role also includes collaboration with external development partners and oversight of production pipelines. This is an opportunity to make a significant creative impact within a collaborative, ambitious game development environment. Lead, manage, coach, and mentor a team of character artists, supporting their professional development, artistic growth, and quality of output. Establish and maintain high artistic standards for character development within Unreal Engine, including workflows, guidelines, and exemplary reference assets. Collaborate closely with Art Directors, Directors, Concept, Environment, Design, Gameplay, Animation, and other disciplines to prototype and develop character assets aligned with project goals. Partner with external development and outsourcing teams to assign, schedule, review, and coordinate character asset production. Contribute to material and character art pipelines, monitor team output, and help identify opportunities to improve production efficiency and quality. Supervise bug distribution and resolution while providing input into custom tools, software, and technical solutions that support the character art team. Stay current with relevant technologies and production techniques, helping the team overcome creative and technical challenges. Provide constructive feedback, communicate priorities clearly, and help maintain a collaborative, respectful, and high-performing team environment. Requirements: 10+ years of professional experience in the video game industry, including at least two shipped titles as a Character Artist; first-person game experience is strongly preferred. Proven experience leading, managing, mentoring, and developing teams of character artists. Expert proficiency with 3D creation and character development tools such as 3ds Max, Maya, ZBrush, Substance Painter, Marvelous Designer, and Unreal Engine. Strong mastery of PBR workflows and texture creation, including baking processes, Substance Painter, and Photoshop. Exceptional traditional art knowledge, with advanced understanding of human anatomy, proportion, composition, volume, lighting, and color. Strong cross-disciplinary collaboration skills and the ability to communicate complex artistic and technical concepts clearly to varied audiences. A proactive, self-motivated approach, with the ability to maintain quality and effectiveness amid changing priorities, ambiguity, and production pressure. Demonstrated emotional intelligence, active listening, and the ability to build trust across teams while delivering and receiving constructive feedback. Strong ownership and organizational skills, with a meticulous eye for detail and a commitment to driving work forward autonomously. A collaborative mindset, positive attitude, and commitment to maintaining a supportive team culture while pursuing ambitious creative standards. Professional proficiency in both French and English is required for candidates located in Quebec, including the ability to collaborate with U.S. and international teams and work with specialized technical documentation. Benefits: Base salary in California of approximately $150,400–$180,000 USD per year , with compensation varying based on location, skills, experience, and other rele

jobgether-jobgether:lever:73355eab-49c5-.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Django)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:73355eab-49c5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Django) based in Israel. Join a fast-growing, international technology environment where your backend expertise will directly support a global connectivity platform. You will build and scale high-performance APIs and mission-critical microservices used by millions of travelers worldwide. The role combines hands-on backend engineering with software architecture responsibilities, particularly around operations, automation, and scalability. You will help strengthen engineering quality through testing, code reviews, documentation, and modern development practices. Working closely with Product and QA teams, you will turn complex business requirements into resilient and maintainable solutions. You will also have the opportunity to tackle technical debt and performance challenges in a high-load environment. This is a fully remote role within a collaborative, international team that values continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and autonomy. Build, maintain, and optimize mission-critical microservices using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework (DRF) . Design and develop scalable APIs capable of supporting high-concurrency traffic and significant usage peaks. Contribute to software architecture, with a particular focus on operations, automation, resilience, and scalable engineering practices. Establish and maintain strong quality frameworks through comprehensive unit testing with Pytest and automated quality checks. Identify and resolve technical debt, performance bottlenecks, inefficient database queries, N+1 problems, and asynchronous processing issues. Design and implement microservices that integrate effectively with complex third-party systems and services. Improve application performance and reliability through profiling, optimization, and appropriate asynchronous programming techniques. Work closely with Product, QA, and other engineering stakeholders across international teams to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. Champion software engineering best practices across the development lifecycle, including design patterns, technical documentation, code reviews, and maintainability. Contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives, helping create efficient and scalable development and operational processes. Act as a technical reference for backend engineering and contribute strategic thinking while remaining hands-on with implementation. Requirements 5+ years of professional backend development experience , with strong expertise in Django and Django REST Framework. Advanced proficiency in Python , with a solid understanding of backend architecture and production software development. Proven experience designing and building microservices architectures and integrating complex third-party applications or ecosystems. Strong experience with unit testing and quality-first development practices, including Pytest or comparable testing frameworks. Practical experience with asynchronous programming and optimizing high-load database queries. Demonstrated ability to identify performance issues and improve application efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Strong understanding of API design, software architecture, design patterns, and maintainable code practices. Experience working with code reviews, technical documentation, automated quality checks, and modern software development processes. Excellent professional English skills ( C1 minimum ) for effective communication in an international, distributed environment. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to express technical ideas clearly and contribute constructively to team decisions. Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach and a willingness to take ownership of technical challenges. Spanish fluency or professional working proficien

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:fb84c603-3697-4388.title: Treasury Manager (Crypto)
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:fb84c603-3697-4388.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Senior Treasury Manager, щоб разом піднімати планку результату. Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі: — Ефективний менеджмент ліквідності: оперативне та стратегічне управління коротко- й середньостроковою ліквідністю на банківських рахунках, у VASP та цифрових гаманцях; — Оптимізація масштабних потоків: контроль великих транскордонних переказів (перекидок) та системних поповнень інфраструктури для безперебійної життєдіяльності бізнесу; — Зовнішні партнерства (Banks & Crypto): побудова та управління відносинами з традиційними банками, платіжними провайдерами, кастодіанами та OTC-платформами; — Розбудова внутрішнього контролю: розробка та впровадження внутрішніх операційних політик, лімітів ліквідності та систем управління ризиками; — Руйнування блокерів: супровід складних або нестандартних казначейських запитів, проходження банківського комплаєнсу та онбордингу нових рішень. На що ти будеш впливати: — Фінансову стійкість компанії через грамотний розподіл оборотного капіталу на глобальному рівні; — Швидкість, гнучкість та вартість масштабування платіжної інфраструктури (як фіатної, так і криптової); — Ефективність прийняття управлінських рішень завдяки створенню поглибленої аналітики та прогнозів ліквідності. Що для нас важливо: — 5+ років досвіду в управлінні казначейством, корпоративними фінансами або ліквідністю у сферах фінтех, IT, банкінгу; — Глибока експертиза в мультивалютному управлінні ліквідністю, cash pooling та розуміння операційних моделей як традиційних банків, так і стейблкоїнів; — Досвід успішної взаємодії та ведення перемовин із банками, фінансовими установами та ліцензованими провайдерами (VASP); — Просунутий рівень Excel та навички візуалізації складних фінансових даних; — Англійська мова на рівні B2+ / C1 (для вільного ведення бізнес-переговорів із міжнародними банківськими інституціями). Буде перевагою: — Досвід роботи з MPC/multisig гаманцями та крипто-кастодіальними рішеннями; — Досвід оптимізації чи побудови казначейської функції з нуля у швидкозростаючих компаніях.
